notes: Single-stage PKI provisioning: parse a key=value spec, drive the openssl CLI to mint a matching key + self-signed certificate for both RSA and EC key types, emit a combined key-then-cert PEM with mode 0600, and record DER fingerprints. Rubric nonzero for tool_breadth (openssl genpkey/req/pkey/x509 plumbing), dependent_stages (key -> cert -> bundle -> fingerprints), reasoning_depth (key-type branching, block ordering), adversarial_inputs (specs with comments/blank lines, differing curves/bits), hidden_case_generalization (unseen specs), quantitative_correctness (bit sizes, validity span, fingerprint equality). No interaction statefulness or pressure; totals bucket to medium.
